method.planes: Existing diagnostic mouth-x planes u=-.45,0,.45; all recorded intersections complete, no cap truncation.
method.selection: Native type0 lower nodes (current mouth-up<-1mm), |native v|<.1 and red>.9; choose smallest |v| independently for outer oral<.001 and inner oral>.999. These are declared geometric anchors, not equivalent anatomical points or thickness.
method.connectivity: Join exact crossing endpoints by sorted original edge IDs, treating t near0/1 as original vertex. Dijkstra along actual triangle-section segments links the two anchors; no nearest spatial welding. All interior selected nodes have degree2.
method.drawCheck: Independently construct actual draw section graph. Select endpoints nearest native anchors spatially, then independently trace draw indices. Resulting coordinate sequences/arc lengths/normal angles match the native paths; global native/draw prefix mapping remains unproven.
method.normalMeasure: Angles between actual adjacent geometric triangle normals, not shader-normal changes. Actual section tangents separately computed at crest.
limits: Arc lengths and anchor separation are not tissue thickness.
Only three cuts and jaw/speak inspected; no whole-surface contact, volume or physiological validation.
Geometric crease evidence does not prove it is the sole visible cause or that any fairing is visually better.

The raw upper label at all three crest edges is true although those points lie on lower return; preserve R05 ownership and use indexed graph distance to lower/upper pair seeds for stable lower selection.
